A key with a quote and a value with angle brackets are written without HTML escaping.
-- changes --
[{"name":"a\"b","ecosystem":"npm","to":">=1.0.0 <2.0.0","method":"override","file":"package.json"}]
-- in:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "overrides": {
    "x": "1.0.0"
  }
}
-- out:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "overrides": {
    "x": "1.0.0",
    "a\"b": ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"
  }
}
